name: item-meta-simple
description: ITEM-META simple rung (2026-07-18, extended for the custom-field delta): per-instance handover metadata (URL/price/brand/model/supplier/description/remarks + user-defined custom key/value fields) on a placed item. Switches to Pro mode, selects the default move-in layout's first item, expands the inspector's 'Notes & link' section, fills the URL/description/remarks inputs, adds a custom field via 'Add field', asserts the store + serialize() output carry the meta (incl. the custom entry), screenshots the filled section, then asserts the section disappears in Simple mode (itemMeta is a pro-tier flag).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: wait-boot-ready
steps.failMessage: Boot never reached bootPhase='ready' + sceneReady — the async move-in furnishing may still be pending

steps.name: pick-first-item
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); const it = s.items[0]; if (!it) throw new Error('No placed items in the default move-in layout'); window.__itemId = it.id; s.selectItem(it.id); return it.id + ' / ' + it.defId; })()

steps.name: inspector-visible
steps.failMessage: Inspector panel did not mount after selecting an item

steps.name: expand-notes-section
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel.inspector .insp-sec-toggle')].find((b) => b.textContent?.includes('Notes & link')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Notes & link section header not found — is the itemMeta flag on in Pro mode?'); if (btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true') btn.click(); })()

steps.name: fill-url
steps.eval: (function(){ const el = document.querySelector('.panel.inspector input[aria-label="Custom item URL"]'); if (!el) throw new Error('URL input not found'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(el, 'https://example.com/product'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.focus(); el.blur(); })()

steps.name: fill-description
steps.eval: (function(){ const el = document.querySelector('.panel.inspector textarea[aria-label="Item description"]'); if (!el) throw new Error('Description textarea not found'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(el, 'A comfortable piece'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.focus(); el.blur(); })()

steps.name: fill-remarks
steps.eval: (function(){ const el = document.querySelector('.panel.inspector textarea[aria-label="Special remarks"]'); if (!el) throw new Error('Remarks textarea not found'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(el, 'existing — retain'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.focus(); el.blur(); })()

steps.name: verify-store-meta
steps.failMessage: Item meta.url was not committed to the store after filling + blurring the URL field

steps.name: verify-serialize-carries-meta
steps.eval: (async () => { const { serialize } = await import('/src/state/schema.ts'); const saved = serialize(window.__store.getState()); const it = saved.items.find((i) => i.id === window.__itemId); if (!it || !it.meta || it.meta.url !== 'https://example.com/product' || it.meta.description !== 'A comfortable piece' || it.meta.remarks !== 'existing — retain') throw new Error('serialize() output missing/incomplete meta: ' + JSON.stringify(it && it.meta)); })()

steps.name: add-custom-field
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel.inspector button')].find((b) => b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Add custom field'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Add custom field button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: fill-custom-key
steps.eval: (function(){ const el = document.querySelector('.panel.inspector input[aria-label="Custom field name"]'); if (!el) throw new Error('Custom field name input not found'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(el, 'Fabric'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.focus(); el.blur(); })()

steps.name: fill-custom-value
steps.eval: (function(){ const el = document.querySelector('.panel.inspector input[aria-label="Custom field value"]'); if (!el) throw new Error('Custom field value input not found'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(el, 'Linen'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.focus(); el.blur(); })()

steps.name: verify-store-custom-field
steps.failMessage: Custom field (Fabric/Linen) was not committed to the store after filling + blurring both inputs

steps.name: verify-section-hidden-in-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.panel.inspector')?.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('Notes & link')) throw new Error('Notes & link section still present in Simple mode: ' + t.slice(0,200)); })()
